notes.title: We have a release date for the sequel, Trap Legend!
notes.notes:
The game will be finally available in July 17, 2020 at 5:00pm (PDT)!
We also have a new video update: 
[previewyoutube=Fv6jq1Doubc;full][/previewyoutube]
